title: Locking Dance Choreography Tutorial for Beginners - Online Dance Class at Home

method.teacher_system: Lara introduces the locking dance style and orientation, breaks down each movement in detail with slow counts, and then guides learners through practicing the full combo repeatedly with music.

practices.what: Breaks down the first locking movement step by step, demonstrating arm crosses and muscle locks slowly.
Practices the first sequence of movements slightly faster while counting out loud.
Turns around to face the back so learners can mirror her movements while facing the same direction.
Puts on the music to practice the learned choreography with the rhythm and beat.
Repeats the first eight counts slowly and then faster with the music multiple times.
Offers a simpler alternative for arm movements if the full version is too much.

adaptations.difficulty: The arm movements combined with the locking motion might be too much.
adaptations.adjustment: Just straighten your arms up and down, it's also all right.

beliefs.belief: Locking relies on fast, distinct arm and hand movements combined with relaxed hips and legs.

moments.says: Welcome back on my channel, my name is Lara and I'm your expert for fitness, sports and dance, and I'm super excited to share my first dance tutorial for beginners with you today.
These movements are mostly large and exaggerated, and I will mirror these movements for you, which means my left leg is your right leg.
If it's too much for you, just straighten your arms up and down, it's also all right.
Yes, great! Okay, one more time slowly.
Maybe pause this video, put yourself some music on and practice this first movement.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling encouraged, capable, and ready to groove step-by-step at their own pace.

struggles.theme: Each combination is difficult and hard to master despite looking easy

clicked.theme: The teacher breaks down every move repeatedly and clearly

requests.theme: Ask for longer dance tutorials and more beginner content

meant.theme: Helped with school PE projects and dance assignments

method.limits: The video does not show partner interaction or detailed floorwork options since this is an upper body and footwork focused locking tutorial.
